business_summary: Roze AI Inc., through its subsidiary, develops AI-enabled fire and disaster-prevention technologies integrating wireless sensing, digital-twin software, and data analytics. The company offers the Disaster AI Platform (DAP), a digital twin AI wireless fire system for fire and disaster monitoring, forecasting, early warning and response, and fire prevention, comprising the Rozeta IoT Platform, the Rozeta Data Platform, and the Rozeta Service Platform. The company's Rozeta IoT Platform includes fire detectors, complex IoT sensors covering smoke, temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, flame, vibration, current, and pressure, along with repeaters, alert devices, and control panels. Its Rozeta Data Platform handles data collection, storage, and processing, while the Rozeta Service Platform provides digital twins, dashboards, and a Metaverse environment. It also designs, manufactures, and sells wireless fire detecting and alarming devices and systems. The company offers Fire4Cast, an AI fire forecasting system that applies anomaly detection, calculates a Fire Risk Index for each building, and integrates Fire Dynamics Simulator data with real-world sensor inputs. It provides RozetaTwin digital-twin software for facility modeling, simulation, evacuation planning, and maintenance workflows, along with the DAP Cloud Service that connects sensor data, AI analysis, and real-time visualization through dashboards, 3D simulation, and Metaverse-based training. Additionally, the company offers So.S Home acoustic sensing for sound-field-based safety applications and RozeVerse and RozeVR immersive fire-response training environments. It also designs and constructs firefighting systems. The company serves corporate customers across commercial buildings, manufacturing plants, power plants, and residential complexes, along with government agencies, the military, public institutions, and individual consumers. Roze AI Inc. was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
business_summary_ko: Roze AI Inc.는 자회사를 통해 무선 감지, 디지털 트윈 소프트웨어 및 데이터 분석을 통합하는 AI 지원 화재 및 재난 예방 기술을 개발합니다. 회사는 화재 및 재난 모니터링, 예측, 조기 경보 및 대응, 화재 예방을 위한 디지털 트윈 AI 무선 소방 시스템인 재난 AI 플랫폼(DAP)을 제공하며, 이는 Rozeta IoT 플랫폼, Rozeta Data Platform 및 Rozeta Service Platform으로 구성됩니다. 이 회사의 Rozeta IoT 플랫폼에는 화재 감지기, 연기, 온도, 습도, 일산화탄소, 화염, 진동, 전류 및 압력을 다루는 복잡한 IoT 센서와 중계기, 경고 장치 및 제어 패널이 포함되어 있습니다. Rozeta Data Platform은 데이터 수집, 저장 및 처리를 처리하고 Rozeta Service Platform은 디지털 트윈, 대시보드 및 Metaverse 환경을 제공합니다. 또한 무선 화재 감지 및 경보 장치와 시스템을 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이상 감지를 적용하고 각 건물의 화재 위험 지수를 계산하며 Fire Dynamics Simulator 데이터를 실제 센서 입력과 통합하는 AI 화재 예측 시스템인 Fire4Cast를 제공합니다.
